{{Quote|I want some coffee. But I guess I'll have to settle for that gondar sweat those machines are puttin' out.|Triv Pothman|<ref name="CotJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>}}
The '''gondar''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Color/Legends|white]]-[[Tooth/Legends|tusked]]<ref name="TC: TToJC" /> and sweaty<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|352|Gondar}}</ref> pit-boars<ref name="Who's Who" /> considered disgusting.<ref name="TCSWE" /> Their tusks were used in [[Armor/Legends|armor]], such as [[Tantel armor/Legends|Tantel armor]],<ref name="Galaxies">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> or as decorations.<ref name="TCSWE" /> While using the alias of [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Tamtel Skreej]] when rescuing a [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|carbonite frozen]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]<ref name="TC: TToJC" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="TERC/TCTToJC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Taster's Choice: The Tale of Jabba's Chef]]'' in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]</ref> [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] was wearing a set of Tantel armor, of which the helmet had curved, white gondar tusks protruding from it.<ref name="TC: TToJC" /> The [[Chandrilan/Legends|Chandrillan]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Triv Pothman]] compared poor-tasting [[coffee]] to the sweat of a gondar while onboard the [[Dreadnought|dreadnaught]] ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]''<ref name="CotJ" /> in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].<ref name="TERC/COTJ">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of [[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Bet you didn't know that the chinstrap of his helmet was made from the tusks of pit-boars.|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="Who's Who" />}}
[[File:Lando_Tamtel_Skreej.jpg|thumb|250px|Lando Calrissian wearing a helmet with gondar tusks]]
Gondar tusks first appeared as part of [[Billy Dee Williams]]' Tamtel Skreej costume, which was designed by [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]] and [[Aggie Guerard Rodgers]] for [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']]<ref name="AoRotJ">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> The movie was released in [[1983]],<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> but the tusks were not identified as belonging to a gondar until ''[[Taster's Choice: The Tale of Jabba's Chef]]'',<ref name="TC: TToJC" /> which was published in ''[[Tales from Jabba's Palace]]'' in [[January]] [[1996]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Gondar tusks also appeared in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', as part of a wearable version of Tantel armor, as well as an in-game painting, ''[[30th Anniversary Bash]]'', given out to players who attended [[Nym's Anniversary Bash]],<ref name="Galaxies" /> which lasted from [[May 23]] to [[June 25]], [[2007]].<ref name="SWG event">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67239&month=052007|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Star Wars Anniversary Bash}}</ref>
